{{Quote|I'm not afraid of Darth Vader. I don't really believe in the 'Force' and all that. I always found a nice vibroblade to be much more useful.|Anonymous commoner|<ref name="SWG:TPS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
'''Vibroblades''' were a type of bladed [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee]] [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapon]] that used ultrasonic vibrations to increase cutting effectiveness.

==Description==
{{Quote|Please put that ''vibroblade'' away. Those devices can be terribly dangerous in the wrong hands!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], to a [[Unidentified RA-7 protocol droid (Sundered Heart)|RA-7 protocol droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|information specialist]]|<ref name="MemoryLoss">{{SWComicCite|7.13|Memory Loss}}</ref>}}
A vibroblade resembled a short [[Sword/Legends|sword]] with a high-tech look and feel<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> and consisted of the same basic design as other [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]]: the weapon's hilt or handle usually contained a compact [[Ultrasonic generator/Legends|ultrasonic vibration generator]], causing the blade to vibrate at an incredible speed, making even the slightest glancing blow become a gaping wound. Vibroblades were dangerous to use against electrical weapons, as they conducted electricity. Electrocution, however, would be the wielder's last concern. Traveling up the length of the blade, the electricity would connect with a vibroblade's [[Energy cell (vibroblade)|energy cell]] and ultrasonic vibration generator. The result would be a miniature explosion with enough force to take off a hand.

Vibroblade design emphasized durability with minimal maintenance. Blades and shafts were constructed of virtually indestructible materials, and the blades incorporated [[self-sharpening diagnostic mode]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

A vibroblade could be fitted with [[cortosis-weave]], allowing it to parry the blows of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[energy sword]]s. The cortosis-weave became less common when the probability of fighting a lightsaber-wielding opponent decreased. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], knowledge of the cortosis-weave had faded, and the [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] mineral itself had become exceedingly rare. A highly adaptable variant of the vibroblade, the prototype vibroblade, could be fitted with a number of weapon enhancements.<ref name="KOTOR1">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

Larger variants of the vibroblade included the [[dire vibroblade]], [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]], [[Sith Tremor Sword]], and [[vibro double-blade]], while smaller variants included the [[Vibrorapier/Legends|vibrorapier]], [[Vibrodagger/Legends|vibrodagger]], [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]], [[Vibro-shiv/Legends|vibro-shiv]], and hand-sized [[Vibroknuckler/Legends|vibroknuckler]] and [[Gauntlet vibroblade/Legends|knuckle plate vibro blade]]. Variant vibroblades created and used by other cultures included the [[Zabrak vibroblade]] used by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] and the [[Echani vibroblade]] used by the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]].

==History==
{{Quote|The hum of the vibroblade gives it away. That's the only reason I still have my face.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], after a bounty hunter attack on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]|<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Shady_characters_with_vibroblades.jpg|thumb|Vibroblades in the hands of criminals.]]
Vibroblades were favored by [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]],<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] throughout the galaxy. They were also used as backup [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]] by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]], and [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]].<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> Since they were popular among criminals, vibroblades were banned on many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], especially in urban areas.

Vibroweapons were common prior to, after, and during the [[Jedi Civil War]], because as [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shields]] became more common, [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], of course, became less viable as a sound weapon. Vibroweapons on the other hand could cut through energy shields (and their users) with ease. Vibroblades were carried as melee weapons by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Neo-Crusader shock trooper|Neo-Crusader Shock Troopers]]as well as [[Officer/Legends|officers]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Mission Vao]] crafted her own [[Mission's Vibroblade|custom-made vibroblade]] which she used to defend herself in the rough [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] around the time she met [[Revan/Legends|Revan]].<ref name="KOTOR1" />

[[File:Jerec3.jpg|thumb|Vibroblades were used even by high ranking imperials such as [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]]]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the bounty hunter [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]] carried a vibroblade.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> [[Clone assassin]]s used vibroblades as their primary weapon.<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Vibroblades were also used as backup weapons by [[Imperial Dungeoneer]]s.<ref name="Force Unleashed Campaign Guide">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Vibroblades were still being used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|first galactic civil war]], even by High Ranking imperials such as the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|inquisitor]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]], who sometimes used it over his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] for mundane tasks like [[Sai cha/Legends|beheading]] uncooperative prisoners.

Despite widespread banning, the use of vibrobladed weaponry continued on isolated, less civilized worlds, such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|skiff]] crew used [[Pike/Legends|pikes]] with vibrobladed cutting edges. Vibroblades were also carried by officers of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and later by [[Galactic Alliance Core Fleet Commando|Core Fleet Elite Commandos]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]]s.<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Around [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Lumiya]], a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]], carried a [[Lumiya's vibroblade|vibroblade]] in her boot. While entertaining the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alema Rar]] at her [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[The Home|home]], Lumiya used it to plunge into her own [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] thigh, without the slightest quiver of pain, to prove the extent of her prosthetic [[Limb/Legends|limb]] replacements. To Rar's astonishment, the blade had absolutely no effect on the Dark Lady, as all of her limbs were [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic]].<ref name="Sacrifice" /> Around the same time, [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] gave her son [[Ben Skywalker]] a [[Ben Skywalker's vibroblade|vibroblade]] with a concealed [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]]. Mara used it to find him whenever she was unable to sense him with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. It was because of Ben's possession of the vibroblade that Mara learned that he was on [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]] when the [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] Prime Minister, [[Dur Gejjen]], was [[Mission to Vulpter|assassinated]] by a [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] assassin, Ben Skywalker himself. Mara later used the tracking device again while she was following [[Lumiya]]; however, Ben had left it in [[Lon Shevu]]'s apartment, and was in fact following Mara.
